items: Raw shark, manta ray or sea turtle
rewards: Access to Miscellania, Etceteria, Neitiznot, Jatizso and the facilities of Rellekka.
Ability to wear and purchase Fremmennik Helms

st.t: Talk to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall.
s: I want to become a Fremennik!

i: Raw shark, manta ray or sea turtle

st.t: Talk to Olaf the Bard north east of the longhall.
Talk to Lalli to the south east of Rellekka.
Return to Rellekka and talk to Askeladden for a pet rock.
Return to Lalli and use a onion, cabbage, potato, and pet rock on their stew. You can find the vegetables growing in the south east of Rellekka.
Talk to Lalli for the golden fleece.
Go south east of Rellekka and cut a branch from the swaying tree
Use a knife on the branch to make an unstrung lyre
Spin the golden fleece into wool using a spinning wheel. The closest wheel is in Seers' Village.
Use the golden wool on your unstrung lyre.

Bring your lyre to the Strange Altar south west of Rellekka. From the north end of the bridge south of Rellekka, walk a bit west to a narrow path heading south into the water. Use either a raw shark, raw sea turtle or raw manta ray on the altar.
i: Raw shark, manta ray or sea turtle

st.t: Return to Rellekka and go in through the back door on the north-east side of the longhall, the one the Longhall Bouncer guards, to reach the stage. Play the enchanted lyre on stage, then talk to Olaf the Bard for his vote.

i: Raw shark, manta ray or sea turtle
Empty inventory slots for vegetables and a pet rock (4)

st.t: Talk to Manni the Reveller in the Rellekka longhall.
Get some beer. There is beer tankard in the Rellekka longhall.
Give the Council workman on the bridge south of Rellekka going to Seer's Village a beer.
Buy some alcohol free beer from the Poison Salesman in the Seer's Village pub.
Return to Rellekka with the strange object, a tinderbox, and low alcohol beer.
Go to the pipe outside the east wall of the longhall. Use a tinderbox on the strange object, then use the lit object on the pipe.
Pick up a keg of beer in the longhall.
Use the low alcohol beer on the keg of beer whilst in the longhall.
Talk to Manni the Reveller to cheat in the competition.
Talk to Sigli south of the longhall for a hunters' talisman.

Tap the hunters' talisman and walk the way the chat message says. Keep doing this until you reach the exact spot, where the talisman makes the Draugen (level 69) appear. A small see-through butterfly follows it. Kill the Draugen.
Return the charged hunters' talisman to Sigli.
Talk to Sigmund the Merchant in the Rellekka market.
Talk to the Sailor on the docks.
Talk to Olaf the Bard east of the longhall.
Talk to Yrsa in her shop west of the market.
Talk to Brundt in the longhall.
Talk to Sigli south of the longhall.
Talk to Skulgrimen north of the longhall.
Talk to the Fisherman on the pier north of the market.
Talk to Swensen the Navigator in his hut south west of the longhall.
Talk to Peer the Seer south west of the market.
Talk to Thorvald north of the longhall.
Talk to Manni the Reveller in the longhall.
Talk to Thora the Barkeep in the longhall.
Talk to Askeladden south of the longhall.
Bring the promissory note to Thora the Barkeep in the longhall.
Bring the cocktail to Manni the Reveller in the longhall.
Bring the champions token to Thorvald north of the longhall.
Bring the warriors' contract to Peer the Seer south west of the market.
Bring the weather forecast to Swensen the Navigator in his hut south west of the longhall.
Bring the sea fishing map to the Fisherman on the pier north of the market.
Bring the unusual fish to Skulgrimen north of the longhall.
Bring the custom bow string to Sigli south of the longhall.
Bring the tracking map to Brundt in the longhall.
Bring the fiscal statement to Yrsa in her shop west of the market.
Bring the sturdy boots to Olaf the Bard east of the longhall.
Bring the ballad to the Sailor on the docks.
Finally, bring the exotic flower to Sigmund the Merchant in the Rellekka market.
Talk to Thorvald north of the longhall.
When you're ready to fight Koschei, go down the ladder.
i: Nothing except for food, potions, and rings of recoil
Optionally a Dramen branch + knife to make a dramen staff once inside Koschei's arena

st.t: Fight Koschei the Deathless and 'kill' him at least 3 times. Dying to his fourth phase is a SAFE death.

i: Nothing except for food, potions, and rings of recoil
Optionally a Dramen branch + knife to make a dramen staff once inside Koschei's arena

st.t: Talk to Swensen the Navigator in his hut south west of the longhall.
Climb down Swensen's ladder.

Go through the portals in this order: south, west, east, north, south, east, north (the first letters spell SWENSEN). Then climb up the ladder, and talk to Swensen if he doesn't give you his vote. A wrong portal leads to a dark room with webs and skeletons: climb the rope and start the portals again.
Talk to Peer the Seer south west of the Rellekka market. You will need to bank all your items. Peer will offer to do this for you.
Try to enter Peer the Seer's house after banking all your items. Peer the Seer will offer to bank everything for you.
Enter the solution to Peer's door.
Go up the ladder.
Search the bookcase in the north of the room for a red herring.
Study the bull's head for a wooden disk.
Study the unicorn's head for an old red disk.
Use the red herring on the cooking range to get sticky red goop.
Use the sticky red goop on the wooden disk to make a second red disk.
Open the trapdoor on the east side and go down.
Use both red disks on the abstract mural to get the vase lid. If you don't get it, search the mural.
Go back upstairs.
Search the cupboard in the south-west of the room for an empty bucket.
Search the chest in the south of the room for an empty jug.
Use the empty bucket on the tap by the cooking range to fill it.
Use the full bucket on the empty jug. The bucket is left 2/5 full.
Empty the full jug into the drain.
Use the 2/5 full bucket on the empty jug.
Use the empty bucket on the tap to fill it again.
Use the full bucket on the 2/3 full jug. The bucket is left 4/5 full.
Use the 4/5 full bucket on the chest with a scale on it, in the north of the room, to get a vase. If the amounts went wrong, empty the jug and bucket and start again from filling the bucket.
Use the empty vase on the tap to fill it.
Use the vase lid on the filled vase.
Use the sealed vase on the frozen table to get a frozen key.
Use the frozen key on the cooking range to thaw it.
Go down the trapdoor on the east side, next to the frozen table. Leaving any other way means redoing parts of the puzzle.
Open the door to leave the Seer's house with the key.
Talk to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall to finish the quest.
